files.name: instagram-reels-tray.json
files.covers: Story tray limited to the first 3 entries, with no live broadcasts.

files.name: instagram-story-data.json
files.covers: Reels media gallery page 1 for the captured tray entries. Normal and video stories are live; the last reel ends with three synthetic stories added by hand (a music sticker, a location sticker and a reel share), because the live tray held none.

files.name: instagram-place.json
files.covers: One synthetic tagged place lookup response for the location sticker story. The live lookup returned a GraphQL error, so this is hand-written with synthetic values.

files.name: instagram-music-asset.json
files.covers: One synthetic music asset lookup response for the music sticker story. Hand-written with synthetic values; no licensed track data is recorded.

files.name: instagram-failure-tray.json
files.covers: A tray failure body (status fail). Hand-written; not served by the recorded client, which answers every request with a success.

files.name: instagram-failure-pagination-page.json
files.covers: A failed pagination page: more pages are announced but the cursor is missing, so pagination cannot advance. Hand-written; not served by the recorded client.
